name: Joshua Juukulius
japaneseName: ヨシュア・ユークリウス
description: Joshua Juukulius is the cousin and adoptive younger brother of Julius Juukulius, and a loyal member of the Anastasia Camp. Deeply devoted to his brother, he accompanied the camp to Pristella in Arc 5, where he tragically fell victim to the Authority of Gluttony.
